title: Pedals Everywhere
style: Pop chant with bouncy four-on-the-floor drums, syncopated handclaps, bright synth stabs, and playful call-and-response energy; verse rides tight percussion and rubbery bass, pre-chorus strips to claps and a rising vocal stack, chorus hits with gang chants and chopped ad-libs on the names. Lead vocal stays close-mic and nimble with doubled hook lines, plus delay throws on shouted phrases, a reverse swell into each chorus, and a glossy punchy mix with sparkling high end.
